You will join a young and dynamic team.
 

Be sure to apply if you are interested!
 

 
 

 

 
 

 
• You are a worker with several years of experience in tiling
 
• A driving licence is required!
 
• You speak fluent Dutch or English

Do you dream of a job with no routine work, where you build a unique finished product from A to Z? For a stable and valued family-owned company in the region, we are looking for a mature Structural Metal Worker / Fitter.

 

As a Structural Metal Worker, you are responsible for the full assembly and custom fitting directly onto the truck chassis:

• Reading Blueprint Plans & Preparation: You read complex technical drawings and bending diagrams like second nature. You saw, drill, cut, and work with lasers based on these plans.
• Assembly & Fitting: You assemble parts with precision down to the millimeter. Think of constructing stairs, doors, frames, and specific structures.
• Metalworking & Bending: You perform the necessary bending and drilling work. Logical reasoning is essential here: when a drawing is challenging, you know exactly how to make the parts fit together seamlessly.
• Light Welding: A small part of your duties includes MIG/MAG welding (assembling/tack welding). However, the main focus is on total assembly.

 Jouw profiel als Constructiemedewerker / Samensteller.

• Experience & Maturity: You have already gained solid and relevant experience in metal construction, assembly, or fitting (e.g., custom doors, stairs, or structures). Due to the complexity of the work, we are looking for a mature candidate who can work independently.
• Technical Insight: You excel at reading blueprint drawings, have excellent spatial awareness, and can reason logically.
• Metalworking Skills: You have experience with various metalworking techniques (drilling, bending, cutting). Experience with or training in MIG/MAG welding is a nice plus, but not a requirement!
• Language Skills: You communicate fluently in English.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

Are you a (recent) graduate with a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences? Are you ready to put your knowledge and skills into practice in a setting where innovation meets purpose?
 

We’re looking for ambitious, detail-oriented professionals to help shape the future of medicine. At our leading biotech company, you won’t just find a job you’ll begin a meaningful, long-term career in advanced biomanufacturing.
 

Your journey starts with comprehensive training, where you’ll learn the fundamentals of aseptic (germ-free) techniques and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), the key standards that guide our industry. You’ll quickly gain confidence with the tools, procedures, and mindset that define high-quality biotech production.
 

After onboarding, you’ll join our dynamic Operations team, working hands-on with cutting-edge technologies and sterile processes. Together with your colleagues, you’ll perform precise manual and aseptic production steps, always following clear protocols to guarantee patient safety and product quality.
 

What your day-to-day will look like:
 

 
• Contributing to aseptic and manual production processes
 
• Working in a cleanroom laboratory environment
 
• Performing production steps in controlled areas (grade A/B/C/D), such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products
 
• Managing equipment, including inspections and maintenance
 
• Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials
 
• Supporting transitions between production zones
 
• Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time 

 
• You’re eager to apply your scientific background and contribute to something meaningful, making a real difference in the lives of patients.
 
• You’re energized by dynamic environments and excited to keep learning and growing within advanced biomanufacturing.
 
• You hold a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences, and you’re ready to take the next step from the classroom to cutting-edge industry.
 
• You value structure and precision, and you feel comfortable working in a sterile (aseptic) setting, wearing the proper cleanroom gear.
 
• High-tech equipment and innovative processes spark your curiosity, you want to be part of what’s next.
 
• You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken.
 
• You’re a real team player with a strong eye for detail, and you understand the importance of following procedures carefully.
 
• You’re flexible and open to working in shifts.
 
• You’re excited about a 4-days-on, 4-days-off schedule that supports both focus and work-life balance.

Your skills

• An analytical mindset when approaching technical issues

Who are you?

• You work independently and organise and prioritise your work with ease

• You are flexible and stress-resistant, even when projects become large and complex
• You stay positive and constructive, even under difficult circumstances

jobs.occupation: Hays - Senior IT Service & Vendor Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Senior IT Service & Vendor Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and performance of IT services delivered by external suppliers. Working in an international multi-vendor environment, you will monitor service delivery, challenge vendors and drive structural improvements across IT services.
Your main responsibilities include

• Leading regular supplier service reviews and contributing to quarterly business reviews.

• Monitoring SLAs, service performance, breaches and supplier actions.

• Challenging vendors on performance, root-cause analyses and recurring service issues.

• Identifying opportunities for structural and continuous service improvement.

• Coordinating issues involving multiple IT suppliers and driving them towards resolution.

• Maintaining the SLA framework, service catalogue, vendor register and renewal calendar.

• Validating supplier invoices, cloud consumption and software licensing against contractual scope.

• Supporting contract renewals and amendments.

• Coordinating service transitions when IT services move between suppliers.

• Contributing to service reporting and overall supplier governance.

What you'll get in return

In return for your expertise, you will receive an attractive salary package including

• Gross monthly salary between EUR5,000 and EUR6,100.

• Company car

• Group and hospitalization insurance

• EUR125 NET/month allowance

• Meal vouchers of EUR8 per worked day and EUR250 eco vouchers per reference year

• Bonus potential of 10% of the annual gross salary, subject to the applicable bonus plan

• Laptop and mobile phone/subscription

• 26 holidays

• A 39-hour working week with flexible working hours and time registration

• After the first three months of office-based onboarding, two teleworking days per week, with fixed days agreed with the supervisor. Teleworking from abroad is not possible.

You combine solid experience in IT Service Management, Service Delivery and Vendor Management with a good technical understanding of infrastructure and cloud environments.

• You have at least 10 years of relevant IT experience, ideally within outsourced or multi-vendor environments.

• You have experience in IT Service Management, Service Delivery, Service Integration, Vendor Management and/or Supplier Governance.

• You have a strong understanding of infrastructure, cloud and security, allowing you to challenge external IT suppliers.

• Experience working with offshore, nearshore and multi-vendor environments is an advantage.

• You are comfortable leading service review meetings involving multiple external suppliers.

• You communicate clearly and diplomatically with technical, business and external stakeholders.

• You are structured, proactive, solution-oriented and able to challenge vendors constructively.

• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is an advantage.

• You have a relevant bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

What you need to do now

Are you interested in this role? Please contact Alexia Brosens from Hays or click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.

You will join a Belgian IT department of approximately 30 professionals who work closely with colleagues and external partners across multiple countries. The environment includes a mix of modern and legacy systems, requiring a pragmatic and adaptable approach to technology and architecture. The company values collaboration, knowledge sharing and sustainable growth while maintaining a strong focus on work-life balance.
Your new role

As a Solution Architect, you play a key role in translating business needs into scalable and secure technology solutions. You work closely with business stakeholders, analysts, developers and architects to define the technical direction of projects and ensure successful implementation.

Your responsibilities include:

• Translating business and IT requirements into end-to-end solution designs

• Creating and documenting architecture and technical designs

• Defining the technologies, integration patterns and architectural standards to be applied

• Analysing how different applications and platforms interact within the organisation

• Supporting the evolution of complex application landscapes

• Ensuring security, quality and architectural consistency across solutions

• Collaborating with business stakeholders and IT teams in Belgium and abroad

• Guiding development teams and providing technical leadership

• Assisting in the resolution of complex technical challenges

• Promoting best practices related to software architecture, integration and application design

You will operate in an international environment where collaboration with both local and offshore teams is part of daily business.
What you'll get in return

You will join a stable international organisation that offers flexibility, autonomy and opportunities for professional growth.

The package includes:

• Gross monthly salary between EUR6.000 and EUR7.100 depending on experience

• Company car

• Meal vouchers (EUR8 per day, with employee contribution)

• Hospitalisation and group insurance

• 35-hour working week

• Flexible working hours

• Hybrid working possibilities and flexibility in organising your agenda

• Easily accessible office location by public transport

• Career development opportunities within an international environment

Training and certification opportunities can be discussed with the hiring manager depending on team priorities and development plans.

For this Solution Architect position, we are looking for an experienced IT professional who combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication skills.

You ideally have:

• Fluency in English, combined with French or Dutch

• At least 8 years of relevant IT experience

• A bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience

• Solid experience with Java-based environments

• Strong knowledge of API architectures, REST APIs and Swagger/OpenAPI

• Experience with MicroServices architectures

• Knowledge of container platforms such as Kubernetes, OpenShift and Docker

• Understanding of authentication and security concepts, including OAuth2 and OpenID Connect

• Experience designing application and solution architectures

• The ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Experience in consultancy or large international organisations is considered a strong asset. Experience within the financial sector is welcomed but not required.
What you need to do now

Are you interested in this role? Please click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV.

Do you have experience working with fabrics and know how to identify different pattern pieces? For a garment manufacturing company in the Tielt region, we are looking for someone to prepare fabrics for the cutting process and correctly sort the cut pattern pieces.

• You set up the machine and monitor the automatic unrolling and layering of the fabric.

• You take into account the fabric direction, warp and weft when preparing the materials

• You identify weaving defects and other irregularities and position the fabric in such a way that defective sections do not end up in the finished garments

• You check that the fabrics are correctly prepared and ready for the cutting machine.

• You collect the cut pieces and sort them according to the correct pattern.

• You group components such as sleeves, collars, front panels and back panels so they can be processed together in the next production stage.

• You follow the production schedule and ensure that the work progresses smoothly and efficiently.

 

• You have knowledge of fabrics and textiles, preferably gained through experience in a garment workshop or textile company.

• You can identify different garment components and pattern pieces.

• You can recognise fabric defects and know how to take them into account when laying out the fabric.

• You work accurately while maintaining a good production pace.

• You can count correctly and distinguish between colours, sizes and quantities.

• You have a sufficient understanding of Dutch to correctly interpret work instructions, numbers and labels. Knowledge of English is also an advantage.

• You are physically fit for the job and can work both independently and as part of a team.

• Sewing skills are not required. However, it is important that you can recognise fabrics and the different components of a garment.

As an Operator in Hot Kitchen Department, you are responsible for independently operating various production machines. In this department, ingredients and prepared products are fried, cooked, steamed, mixed, and boiled.

Your responsibilities include operating equipment such as cooking kettles, filling machines, mixers, and combi steam ovens. You also prepare dishes and food components in accordance with our quality, hygiene, and safety standards.

 

What does the job involve?

As a Kitchen Operator, you are the right-hand person of the Team Leader in the Hot Kitchen Department, supporting them in the production of prepared dishes and food components.

You are responsible for preparing and carrying out recipes. Your tasks include:

• Taking over the duties of kitchen staff in their absence.

• Carrying out the necessary quality checks on raw materials and preparing them for processing when required. Depending on the workload, you work together with kitchen staff, providing them with clear instructions and guidance to ensure that their tasks are carried out correctly.

• Independently following and executing recipes in accordance with quality standards and IFS requirements.

• Ensuring that industrial equipment is properly cleaned after and between each production run, in accordance with hygiene regulations.

• Preparing spice blends according to the recipes when the Goods Receiving employee is absent.

• Correctly preparing frozen ingredients and recipe components according to the production order.

• Labelling semi-finished products and recording their use in our computer system.

• Recording cooling temperatures.

Requirements:

• You have a very good command of Dutch (speaking, reading, writing, and understanding). A good knowledge of English and/or French is an advantage.

• You are comfortable with basic calculations, reading weights, and using weighing scales.

• You have completed training in a culinary field (institutional catering, chef, catering assistant, or butcher) or have equivalent experience.

• You are familiar with food safety regulations.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are flexible and enjoy the challenge of switching between different departments.

• You can work well under pressure. Things can get quite busy at Marblo! 

• You maintain a neat and well-groomed appearance. For hygiene and safety reasons, gel nails, excessive make-up, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted in our production areas.

Job Description

As a Dispatch and Labelling Line Supervisor  you will have a varied and responsible role.

Under the guidance of the Dispatch Team Leader, you will ensure that labelling and packaging activities are carried out correctly, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards.

You will coordinate and guide the employees working on the production line, ensuring that every product meets the applicable quality and food safety requirements, as well as customer specifications.

You will gradually grow into your role. You will start by being responsible for one production line. As you gain experience, the aim is for you to be able to operate and supervise all lines.

The Line Supervisor has an operational, monitoring, and coordinating role on the shop floor. You will ensure that the daily production schedule is completed within the allocated time while maintaining the required quality standards.

 

A selection of your responsibilities:

• Allocate tasks, provide clear work instructions, and guide employees working in filling and labelling. You will also help train new colleagues.

• Set up, operate, and change over packaging and labelling machines. Troubleshoot minor technical issues independently and report defects to the technical department in a timely manner.

• Check labels: use the ERP system to assign the correct production order to the right line and ensure that every product receives the correct label.

• Perform and record quality checks, including metal detection, residual oxygen measurements, visual packaging inspections, seal integrity checks, and final product weight checks.

• Ensure that each customer's packaging, labelling, and palletising instructions are followed correctly. Check stacking patterns, quantities, and pallet labels.

• Monitor compliance with HACCP, IFS Food, Food Defense, and hygiene requirements, and report any deviations to the Quality Department or your supervisor.

 

Who are you?

 

• You have a good command of both Dutch and English, including speaking, understanding, and reading. French is an advantage!

• You have experience working as an operator in another company, preferably in the food industry.

• You are familiar with packaging and labelling machines, including operating, setting up, and changing them over.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are stress-resistant and comfortable working at a fast pace on machinery. Things can get quite busy at Kjure-Marblo!

• You have strong administrative skills and are confident using computers.

• As working in the food industry involves strict quality, hygiene, and safety requirements, gel nails, excessive make-up, eyelash extensions, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted. We prefer a natural look. :-)

• You are comfortable working in a cold environment, with temperatures around 4°C.

Oversee contractor-led tool installations for the Málaga cleanroom (Fab 5) project, with a focus on safety and conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines. 

 

What you will doFor the Málaga Fab 5 project, tool installations will be performed by the contractor. imec’s role focuses on safety oversight and validating that the installations conform to imec’s required standards and guidelines. That’s where you come in. Onboarding and training will take place in Leuven, Belgium until mid-2028, after which the position location will transfer to Málaga, Spain.  
As Project Lead, your role combines contractor oversight, safety follow-up and installation conformity validation on behalf of imec. 
The contractor is responsible for installation execution and day-to-day coordination of the installation works. You will monitor progress, review safety and quality matters, and coordinate interfaces with imec stakeholders, keeping a clear distinction between contractor execution and imec oversight. 
Your focus is to validate conformity with imec’s installation standards, guidelines and safety requirements. You will review contractor deliverables and installation evidence, follow up deviations and corrective actions, and support installation acceptance by imec rather than directly managing execution. 
You will: 
 
 

• Oversee contractor-led installations and coordinate interfaces with imec 

• Review contractor schedules and monitor progress against agreed milestones 

• Flag scope deviations and their impact on timelines, budgets and priorities 

• Validate installation conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines through reviews, inspections and supporting records 

• Provide safety oversight and follow up contractor actions on safety and quality findings 

• Keep internal stakeholders and external partners informed 

• Escalate risks and non-conformities, track corrective actions and review evidence for installation acceptance 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Electromechanical Engineering.  

• You have at least 5 years of relevant technical experience.  

• You have experience overseeing contractor-led technical projects and reviewing installations against defined standards and guidelines.  

• You communicate openly and proactively with both internal customers and external partners about the status of ongoing work, and you escalate issues promptly when needed.  

• You adapt easily to changes and time pressure and combine a practical mindset with a strong focus on safety, quality and conformity.

What you will do
 

Imec performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment.
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with business analysts and software developers for our equipment integration solution. You will be supported by dedicated test engineers. 

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates. 

• You perform the crucial task of analyzing how our equipment integration software platform can implement business requirements. The specifications to be passed on to internal and more often external developers can range from straightforward configuration to additional logic to be defined. 

• Some business requirements will result in equipment integration being dependent on related configuration or even features to be implemented in adjacent applications, especially the MES. You thus will gain sufficient knowledge about adjacent CIM applications to effectively collaborate with their business analysts and functional analysts. 

• You have an active role in test preparation and debugging. You will be supported by our PMO team during all phases of the software lifecycle.

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are dependable. 

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment. 

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

You will be a member of the Defect Inspection Engineer team (DIE) which is part of the Inspection and Metrology Characterization group (IMC). The IMC group is responsible for the metrology and defectivity process portfolio and tools and follows up processes under evaluation/validation for furture needs. As process engineer in the DIE team, you will be responsible for tools and processes:
 
 

• Process & tool qualification, monitor stability, implement improvements for improved quality and cycle time. 

• Troubleshooting defectivity related issues reported by the First Line Support which cannot be resolved by themselves. 

• Analyze data utilizing sound statistical methods and present summaries to peers and management. 

• Fulfill requests for new applications and create the tool recipes. 

• Investigate tool and recipe issues, focus on root cause analysis and development of long-term solutions.
